name: Role classification
description: How an office is filled. Kept deliberately small and mechanism-based rather than title-based, because job titles do not translate across countries but the mechanism of appointment does.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Appointed
hasDefinedTerm.description: Filled by decision of another officeholder or body.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Employed
hasDefinedTerm.description: Filled through an employment process; a staff position rather than an office of state.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Ex officio
hasDefinedTerm.description: Held automatically by virtue of holding another office. The holder is determined by the other Post, not by a separate process.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Volunteer
hasDefinedTerm.description: Unpaid, typically on an advisory board or commission.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Hereditary
hasDefinedTerm.description: Held by inheritance. Rare, but real in several countries; included so those systems need not misreport as 'appointed'.
